mcp.title: Connect via MCP
mcp.description: Manage your invoices with any AI assistant. Ask it to "create an invoice" or "update line items". To save your invoices and access them from any device, generate a token at api.pilihpendidikan.com/connect.
mcp.step1: Visit api.pilihpendidikan.com/connect and sign in to generate your personal MCP token — required to save your invoices to the cloud.
mcp.step2: Add the MCP server to your client — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Zed, and more.
mcp.step3: Paste your personal URL into your client and restart it.
